text.KJV: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
text.ASV: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we beheld, and our hands handled, concerning the Word of life
text.WEB: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

text.KJV: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
text.ASV: (and the life was manifested, and we have seen, and bear witness, and declare unto you the life, the eternal `life', which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us);
text.WEB: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

text.KJV: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: that which we have seen and heard declare we unto you also, that ye also may have fellowship with us: yea, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ:
text.WEB: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
text.ASV: and these things we write, that our joy may be made full.
text.WEB: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

text.KJV: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
text.ASV: And this is the message which we have heard from him and announce unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
text.WEB: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

text.KJV: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
text.ASV: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
text.WEB: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don’t tell the truth.

text.KJV: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
text.ASV: but if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
text.WEB: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.

text.KJV: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
text.ASV: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
text.WEB: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

text.KJV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text.ASV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text.WEB: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

text.KJV: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
text.ASV: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
text.WEB: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

text.KJV: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
text.ASV: My little children, these things write I unto you that ye may not sin. And if any man sin, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
text.WEB: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

text.KJV: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for our's only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
text.ASV: and he is the propitiation for our sins; and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
text.WEB: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

text.KJV: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
text.ASV: And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
text.WEB: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

text.KJV: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
text.ASV: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;
text.WEB: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

text.KJV: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
text.ASV: but whoso keepeth his word, in him verily hath the love of God been perfected. Hereby we know that we are in him:
text.WEB: But whoever keeps his word, God’s love has most certainly been perfected in him. This is how we know that we are in him:

text.KJV: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
text.ASV: he that saith he abideth in him ought himself also to walk even as he walked.
text.WEB: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

text.KJV: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
text.ASV: Beloved, no new commandment write I unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning: the old commandment is the word which ye heard.
text.WEB: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

text.KJV: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
text.ASV: Again, a new commandment write I unto you, which thing is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shineth.
text.WEB: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shines.

text.KJV: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
text.ASV: He that saith he is in the light and hateth his brother, is in the darkness even until now.
text.WEB: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother, is in the darkness even until now.

text.KJV: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
text.ASV: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.
text.WEB: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

text.KJV: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
text.ASV: But he that hateth his brother is in the darkness, and walketh in the darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because the darkness hath blinded his eyes.
text.WEB: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

text.KJV: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
text.ASV: I write unto you, `my' little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
text.WEB: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

text.KJV: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
text.ASV: I write unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the evil one. I have written unto you, little children, because ye know the Father.
text.WEB: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

text.KJV: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
text.ASV: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the evil one.
text.WEB: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

text.KJV: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
text.ASV: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
text.WEB: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

text.KJV: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
text.ASV: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the vain glory of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
text.WEB: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

text.KJV: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
text.ASV: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
text.WEB: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

text.KJV: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
text.ASV: Little children, it is the last hour: and as ye heard that antichrist cometh, even now have there arisen many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last hour.
text.WEB: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

text.KJV: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
text.ASV: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us: but `they went out', that they might be made manifest that they all are not of us.
text.WEB: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

text.KJV: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
text.ASV: And ye have an anointing from the Holy One, and ye know all the things.
text.WEB: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

text.KJV: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
text.ASV: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
text.WEB: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

text.KJV: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
text.ASV: Who is the liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, `even' he that denieth the Father and the Son.
text.WEB: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

text.KJV: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
text.ASV: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also.
text.WEB: Whoever denies the Son, the same doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

text.KJV: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
text.ASV: As for you, let that abide in you which ye heard from the beginning. If that which ye heard from the beginning abide in you, ye also shall abide in the Son, and in the Father.
text.WEB: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

text.KJV: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
text.ASV: And this is the promise which he promised us, `even' the life eternal.
text.WEB: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

text.KJV: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
text.ASV: These things have I written unto you concerning them that would lead you astray.
text.WEB: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

text.KJV: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
text.ASV: And as for you, the anointing which ye received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any one teach you; but as his anointing teacheth you; concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, ye abide in him.
text.WEB: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

text.KJV: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
text.ASV: And now, `my' little children, abide in him; that, if he shall be manifested, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
text.WEB: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

text.KJV: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
text.ASV: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one also that doeth righteousness is begotten of him.
text.WEB: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

text.KJV: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
text.ASV: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called children of God; and `such' we are. For this cause the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
text.WEB: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

text.KJV: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
text.ASV: Beloved, now are we children of God, and it is not yet made manifest what we shall be. We know that, if he shall be manifested, we shall be like him; for we shall see him even as he is.
text.WEB: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. But we know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.

text.KJV: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
text.ASV: And every one that hath this hope `set' on him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
text.WEB: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

text.KJV: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
text.ASV: Every one that doeth sin doeth also lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
text.WEB: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

text.KJV: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
text.ASV: And ye know that he was manifested to take away sins; and in him is no sin.
text.WEB: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and in him is no sin.

text.KJV: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
text.ASV: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither knoweth him.
text.WEB: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

text.KJV: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
text.ASV: `My' little children, let no man lead you astray: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous:
text.WEB: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

text.KJV: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
text.ASV: he that doeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. To this end was the Son of God manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
text.WEB: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

text.KJV: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
text.ASV: Whosoever is begotten of God doeth no sin, because his seed abideth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is begotten of God.
text.WEB: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him; and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

text.KJV: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
text.ASV: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
text.WEB: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

text.KJV: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
text.ASV: For this is the message which ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another:
text.WEB: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another;

text.KJV: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
text.ASV: not as Cain was of the evil one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
text.WEB: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one, and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

text.KJV: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
text.ASV: Marvel not, brethren, if the world hateth you.
text.WEB: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

text.KJV: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
text.ASV: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not abideth in death.
text.WEB: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

text.KJV: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
text.ASV: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
text.WEB: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

text.KJV: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
text.ASV: Hereby know we love, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
text.WEB: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

text.KJV: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
text.ASV: But whoso hath the world's goods, and beholdeth his brother in need, and shutteth up his compassion from him, how doth the love of God abide in him?
text.WEB: But whoever has the world’s goods, and sees his brother in need, and closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

text.KJV: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
text.ASV: `My' Little children, let us not love in word, neither with the tongue; but in deed and truth.
text.WEB: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

text.KJV: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
text.ASV: Hereby shall we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our heart before him:
text.WEB: And by this we know that we are of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,

text.KJV: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
text.ASV: because if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
text.WEB: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

text.KJV: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
text.ASV: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, we have boldness toward God;
text.WEB: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

text.KJV: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
text.ASV: and whatsoever we ask we receive of him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
text.WEB: and whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

text.KJV: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
text.ASV: And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he gave us commandment.
text.WEB: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

text.KJV: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
text.ASV: And he that keepeth his commandments abideth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
text.WEB: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

text.KJV: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
text.ASV: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
text.WEB: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

text.KJV: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
text.ASV: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
text.WEB: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

text.KJV: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
text.ASV: and every spirit that confesseth not Jesus is not of God: and this is the `spirit' of the antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it cometh; and now it is in the world already.
text.WEB: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God, and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

text.KJV: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
text.ASV: Ye are of God, `my' little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.
text.WEB: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

text.KJV: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
text.ASV: They are of the world: therefore speak they `as' of the world, and the world heareth them.
text.WEB: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

text.KJV: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
text.ASV: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he who is not of God heareth us not. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
text.WEB: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

text.KJV: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
text.ASV: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is begotten of God, and knoweth God.
text.WEB: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God.

text.KJV: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
text.ASV: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
text.WEB: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

text.KJV: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
text.ASV: Herein was the love of God manifested in us, that God hath sent his only begotten Son into the world that we might live through him.
text.WEB: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

text.KJV: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
text.ASV: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son `to be' the propitiation for our sins.
text.WEB: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

text.KJV: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
text.ASV: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
text.WEB: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

text.KJV: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
text.ASV: No man hath beheld God at any time: if we love one another, God abideth in us, and his love is perfected in us:
text.WEB: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

text.KJV: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
text.ASV: hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
text.WEB: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

text.KJV: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
text.ASV: And we have beheld and bear witness that the Father hath sent the Son `to be' the Saviour of the world.
text.WEB: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

text.KJV: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
text.ASV: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abideth in him, and he in God.
text.WEB: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

text.KJV: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
text.ASV: And we know and have believed the love which God hath in us. God is love; and he that abideth in love abideth in God, and God abideth in him.
text.WEB: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

text.KJV: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
text.ASV: Herein is love made perfect with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as he is, even so are we in this world.
text.WEB: In this love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so are we in this world.

text.KJV: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
text.ASV: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.
text.WEB: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

text.KJV: We love him, because he first loved us.
text.ASV: We love, because he first loved us.
text.WEB: We love him, because he first loved us.

text.KJV: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
text.ASV: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, cannot love God whom he hath not seen.
text.WEB: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

text.KJV: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
text.ASV: And this commandment have we from him, that he who loveth God love his brother also.
text.WEB: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

text.KJV: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
text.ASV: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God: and whosoever loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
text.WEB: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

text.KJV: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
text.ASV: Hereby we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.
text.WEB: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

text.KJV: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
text.ASV: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
text.WEB: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

text.KJV: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
text.ASV: For whatsoever is begotten of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that hath overcome the world, `even' our faith.
text.WEB: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

text.KJV: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
text.ASV: And who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
text.WEB: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

text.KJV: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
text.ASV: This is he that came by water and blood, `even' Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and with the blood.
text.WEB: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

text.KJV: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
text.ASV: And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is the truth.
text.WEB: For there are three who testify:

text.KJV: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
text.ASV: For there are three who bear witness, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and the three agree in one.
text.WEB: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

text.KJV: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
text.ASV: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for the witness of God is this, that he hath borne witness concerning his Son.
text.WEB: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

text.KJV: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
text.ASV: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in him: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he hath not believed in the witness that God hath borne concerning his Son.
text.WEB: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

text.KJV: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
text.ASV: And the witness is this, that God gave unto us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
text.WEB: The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

text.KJV: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
text.ASV: He that hath the Son hath the life; he that hath not the Son of God hath not the life.
text.WEB: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

text.KJV: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
text.ASV: These things have I written unto you, that ye may know that ye have eternal life, `even' unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God.
text.WEB: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

text.KJV: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
text.ASV: And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us:
text.WEB: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

text.KJV: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
text.ASV: and if we know that he heareth us whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
text.WEB: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

text.KJV: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
text.ASV: If any man see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and `God' will give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: not concerning this do I say that he should make request.
text.WEB: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is a sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

text.KJV: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
text.ASV: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
text.WEB: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is a sin not leading to death.

text.KJV: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
text.ASV: We know that whosoever is begotten of God sinneth not; but he that was begotten of God keepeth himself, and the evil one toucheth him not.
text.WEB: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

text.KJV: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
text.ASV: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in the evil one.
text.WEB: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

text.KJV: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
text.ASV: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, `even' in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
text.WEB: We know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

text.KJV: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
text.ASV: `My' little children, guard yourselves from idols.
text.WEB: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
